requiredQualityGates: runtime images remain maximum-quality cinematic photorealistic first-person world identities; byte caps never authorize visible degradation

each runtime image has direct import, emitted byte and SHA-256 identity, provenance, truthful source/output dimensions, accessible alternative treatment, responsive crops, grayscale review, and explicit placeholder retirement
every generated lineage is inspected at original resolution against required and forbidden material, occlusion, ambiguity, and non-route readings before integration
deterministic enlargement is disclosed and never described as native resolution; contextual registration is not called a literal crop without pixel proof

the browser-safe PY-017 path remains pure, session-only, sanitized-replica-only, private-free, deterministic, and truthfully labeled as approved-shape validation rather than arbitrary Python or real environment execution

learner source, environment snapshots or values, records, working ledger, cases, answers, reasoning, feedback, diagnostics, credentials, endpoints, payloads, responses, prompts, and temporary state never enter durable persistence
every emitted JavaScript and CSS chunk is aggregated
every runtime media file is counted and classified by SHA-256 against the accepted TD-008 set
all accepted TD-008 runtime media identities remain present
new runtime audio, font, video, source-map, Python/WASM runtime, and network payloads are rejected

focused, related, full, validator, build, served identity, non-overlapping E2E, four-layout accessibility review, fixture exclusion, QA restoration, stable-candidate freeze, and as-built reconciliation remain mandatory
